name: Chicken night: curry / stir-fry / fajitas (Tuesday)
title: Chicken

steps.text: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion.
Rice on (curry), or warm the wraps later (fajitas).
Chicken in a hot pan with a little oil until cooked through (8-10 min).
Veg in, then the sauce or spice mix.

shopping: Curry sauce / stir-fry sauce / fajita kit
